scenes.title: Half don't make it
scenes.sub: Only about half of new businesses last five years.
scenes.sub_html: Only about half of new businesses last five years.

lines.say: There are over thirty six million small businesses in America.
lines.show: There are over 36 million small businesses in America.

lines.say: So how many new ones actually last?
lines.show: So how many new ones actually last?

lines.say: Small businesses are ninety nine point nine percent of all U.S. businesses.
lines.show: Small businesses are 99.9% of all U.S. businesses.

lines.say: Eighty two percent have no paid employees. The owners run it themselves.
lines.show: 82% have no paid employees. The owners run it themselves.

scenes.heading: Still open after
scenes.source: New employer establishments, BLS data 1994 to 2022, via SBA

lines.say: For new businesses with employees, about two in three last two years.
lines.show: For new businesses with employees, about 2 in 3 last two years.

lines.say: About half make it five years. About one in three make it ten.
lines.show: About half make it five years. About 1 in 3 make it ten.

scenes.heading: In 2023
scenes.source: Business locations. BLS Business Employment Dynamics, via SBA

lines.say: In twenty twenty three, one point three million business locations opened.
About one point two million closed for good.
Still, small businesses created sixty one percent of America's net new jobs since nineteen ninety five.
lines.show: Still, small businesses created 61% of America's net new jobs since 1995.

lines.say: Before you start, write a plan and track your money.
lines.show: Before you start, write a plan and track your money.

lines.say: The S B A's SCORE program connects you with a business mentor at no cost.
lines.show: The SBA's SCORE program connects you with a business mentor at no cost.

scenes.takeaway: About half last five years. Go in with a plan.
scenes.source: Data: SBA Office of Advocacy FAQ 2026 (BLS, Census)
